proposition: He followed Shāhrukh back to Herat and spent the last year or so of his life in weekly attendance at court, waiting for a review of his case that never came in time.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II (1431-32), addressed to Bāysunghur

mediation.note: 'never came in time' is R1's paraphrase of MK: to little real effect, he died frustrated
